<?php
$inputString = "";
$stdin = fopen('php://stdin', 'r');
while (!feof($stdin)) {
    $inputString .= fread($stdin, 8192);
}
fclose($stdin);

$inputString = trim($inputString);
$lines = explode("\n", $inputString);
$lines = array_map('trim', $lines);

$currentLine = 0;
function readLine() {
    global $lines, $currentLine;
    return $lines[$currentLine++];
}

function main() {
    $a = readLine();
    if (strtoupper($a) === $a) {
        echo strtolower($a) . "\n";
    } else if (strtolower($a[0]) . strtoupper(substr($a, 1)) === $a) {
        echo strtoupper($a[0]) . strtolower(substr($a, 1)) . "\n";
    } else {
        echo $a . "\n";
    }
}

main();
?>
